read: js:(function(){ const C=GC.Spread.Sheets.Comments; const c=sheet.comments.add(0,0,'hi'); c.width(200); c.height(100); c.autoSize(true); c.backColor('#ffff00'); c.foreColor('red'); c.fontFamily('Arial'); c.fontSize('12px'); c.fontStyle('italic'); c.fontWeight('bold'); c.textDecoration(1); c.horizontalAlign(2); c.opacity(0.5); c.showShadow(true); c.displayMode(C.DisplayMode.alwaysShown); c.commentState(C.CommentState.active); c.location(new GC.Spread.Sheets.Point(30,40)); c.indicatorColor('#00ff00'); c.indicatorSize(8); c.zIndex(900); c.locked(false); c.lockText(false); c.dynamicMove(true); c.dynamicSize(true); c.padding({top:1,right:2,bottom:3,left:4}); return c.toJSON(); })()
